messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up.

output.original_text: Went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up.
output.joy: I happily went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up!
output.sadness: I went to the doctor on Sunday, feeling down, to get my knee all bandaged up.
output.fear: I nervously went to the doctor on Sunday, worried about getting my knee all bandaged up.
output.anger: I was so frustrated to have to go to the doctor on Sunday just to get my knee all bandaged up.
output.surprise: I was surprised to find myself at the doctor on Sunday getting my knee all bandaged up.
output.disgust: I felt a wave of disgust going to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up.
